file_changed_on_disk: File changed on disk since it was loaded: {path}. Save again to overwrite.
tle_suggestion: Time limit exceeded — check the algorithm's complexity or for an infinite loop.
wa_whitespace_suggestion: Output matches after trimming trailing whitespace/line endings — check formatting.
output_invalid_utf8: Output contains non-UTF-8 bytes (the «�» character marks a replaced invalid byte). The solution likely prints raw bytes (sys.stdout.buffer.write) or uses a wrong encoding — emit text as UTF-8.
specify_path_file_or_folder: Specify a path to a file or folder.
specify_path_folder: Specify a path to a folder.
specify_path_file: Specify a path to a file.
content_length_required: The Content-Length header is required and must be a non-negative number.
body_too_large: Request body exceeds the limit of {limit} bytes.
body_invalid_json: Request body must be valid JSON.
body_not_object: Request body must be a JSON object.
feedback_unknown_kind: Unknown feedback type. Allowed: bug, idea, task-problem.
path_outside_workspace: Path outside the server's working directory: {path}
server_sandbox_active: 🔒 OS sandbox enabled (--sandbox): code runs isolated
server_history_active: 📈 Run history enabled: the «Learn» section fills up as you grade (--no-history to disable)
server_workspace_confined: Working directory: {workspace}  (paths outside it are rejected with 403)
server_workspace_unconfined: Working directory: {workspace}  (path confinement DISABLED via --no-root-confinement — any path on disk is accessible)
too_many_runs: Too many active runs (limit {limit}). Wait for the current runs to finish and retry.
consent_required: Consent required: the AI hint sends your code and its input/output to the AI provider. Nothing is sent over the network without your explicit consent.
stepik_auth_required: Not authorized with Stepik: set up OAuth (secrets.json) in the “Task downloader” section. Submitting is impossible without a token.
stepik_no_step_id: Could not determine the Stepik step: no meta.json with step_id. Submitting is available for tasks fetched by the downloader.

history_save_failed: ⚠️ Could not save the setting to .grader_settings.json ({error}). The change applies to this session only.
server_start_failed: ⚠️ Could not start the web server ({error}). The port may be busy. Returning to the menu.
nudge_enable_history: 💡 Some tests failed. Enable run-history recording (menu item 7) — the «Learn» section will collect your frequent mistakes.

feedback_confirm: Open the browser with the prefilled form? [Y/n]:

path_dialog_hint: (press Enter with no input to open a file/folder picker, if available)

enter_folder_with_solutions_path: Enter path to folder with solutions:
no_solutions_found:
No solution files found in: {path}
   Expected names: task.py, task1.py, task1_2.py (task*.py pattern).
   No task yet? Download it from Stepik — menu item 8 or python -m stepik_grader.downloader.

expected_tests_subfolder: Expected: tests/ subfolder next to solution files.
micro_mem_note:
* Py-heap — peak Python-heap (tracemalloc) for stdin blocks / RSS for function blocks;
    tracemalloc does not see C-extension allocations (numpy, etc.).
cache_hit: ✅ Cache is up to date: no tests re-run (0 changes).
cache_summary: ✅ Cache: {hits} of {total} solutions served from cache.
stats_no_data: No data — stats recording is off (--stats/[tool.stepik-grader] record_stats) or hasn't accumulated yet.
insights_no_data: No insights yet — run solutions with history on (--history) to gather «Learn» cards.

dl_github_empty: ⚠️ GitHub: none of the links yielded tests
dl_tests_not_found: ⚠️ No tests found (no ZIP, table or GitHub links) — the other files are saved
launcher_window_title: Stepik Python Grader — web interface launcher
launcher_mode_simple: Plain server — no isolation (faster, works everywhere)
launcher_port_invalid: Invalid port — enter a number between 1 and 65535
launcher_port_range: Port is out of the 1–65535 range
launcher_port_busy: Port {port} is busy — choose another one
progress_export_empty: History is empty — no runs yet.
watch_dependency_missing: --watch requires the watchfiles package: pip install "stepik-grader[watch]"

⚠️ File already exists: {path}
   Delete/rename it to regenerate, or add the tasks manually (see README).
bench_skipped_not_ac: did not pass the tests: {passed} of {total} (first failure: {verdict})
source_not_a_solution: Source view is limited to solution files (.py); requested: {name}
secrets_path_not_json: The secrets.json path must point to a .json file; got: {name}
secrets_path_occupied: File {name} already exists and does not look like secrets.json — refusing to overwrite so unrelated data is not destroyed.
stepik_network_error: Could not reach Stepik: {error}. Check your connection and retry — no need to re-issue the token.
history_purge_shared_key: Warning: key «{task}» covers more than one task — the key is currently the folder name, so same-named folders from different courses share history.
ai_consent_revoked: 🔒 AI hint consent revoked. You will be asked again on the next --ai-hints.
ai_consent_absent: 🔒 AI hint consent was never given — nothing to revoke.
lint_skipped_no_ruff: Style check skipped: ruff is not installed. Install the extra: pip install stepik-python-grader[lint].
insights_no_data_menu: No insights yet. Turn on run history (menu item 7) and grade a few solutions — the “Learn” section will collect your frequent mistakes.
grade_downloaded_many: Downloaded {count} tasks. Offering the last one (the rest are available via menu items 1/2).
ai_skipped_no_provider: AI hints (--ai-hints) skipped: no provider configured. Set [tool.stepik-grader] ai_base_url and ai_model (the key lives in the env variable named by ai_api_key_env), e.g. ollama http://localhost:11434/v1 (no key) or a cloud OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Without configuration nothing is sent over the network. See docs/use/grader-workflow.md.
ai_skipped_insecure_url: AI hints (--ai-hints) skipped: provider address {url} is not accepted. Allowed are https (any host) and http only to the local loopback (http://localhost:11434/v1 for ollama). Over http to a remote host your solution code and key would travel in clear text. Nothing was sent over the network.
ai_consent_notice: An AI hint will send your code and its input/output to an external AI provider. A local provider (ollama, for example) is recommended — then the data never leaves your machine. Consent is asked once and stored in {settings_file}.
ai_consent_prompt: Send your code to the AI provider? [y/N]:
ai_consent_declined: AI hints skipped — consent not given. Nothing was sent over the network.
ai_skipped_consent_required: AI hints (--ai-hints) skipped: a one-time explicit consent to send code to the AI provider is required, and this session is non-interactive. Run the grader interactively once to give consent (or enable hints in the web interface). Nothing was sent over the network.
ai_hints_capped: … remaining AI hints skipped: the per-run cap of {limit} was reached ([tool.stepik-grader] ai_max_hints).
